draft.text: I’m pleased to announce the release of *From Token to Fleet*, a practical guide to scaling LLM systems from a single token to a fleet of GPUs. The book breaks down the infrastructure decisions, performance tuning, and deployment patterns that turn a simple inference request into a distributed workload across multiple GPUs. Readers will walk away with actionable blueprints they can implement immediately to improve latency, throughput, and resource utilization in production LLM pipelines.
